metric_caveat: Old onset_ms is established target-directed response, not first-any motion. New raw_first_any_onset_ms uses same-polarity5sample noise threshold in either direction; shorter raw excursions are retained. Initial wrong-way motion may be genuine, particularly with a free case. Median replacement/filtering is not proof of an electrical artifact. Counts/fullspan, not calibrated shaft angles or scope-edge timing.

conditions.interpretation: Provisional fixture-dependent electrical wiper response; free-case data cannot identify fixed-body dynamics or gearlash.

overshoot_noise_review.interpretation: Small filtered peak-selection excursions are not resolved physical overshoot under the declared3sigma raw-noise criterion. Raw excursions and impulse replacements remain available.

derivative_window_sensitivity_review.interpretation: Window-dependent electrical slope estimate within movement support; not a calibrated instantaneous physical velocity.
